description: Updates an existing Trello label's attributes (color, name, or associated board) by its ID; the label must exist.

color.description: The new color for the label. Provide a valid Trello label color name or 'null' to remove the color. If omitted, the color remains unchanged.
color.title: Color

idBoard.description: The ID of the board to which the label should be moved or associated. If omitted, the label's board association remains unchanged.
idBoard.title: Id Board

idLabel.description: The ID of the label to update.
idLabel.title: Id Label

name.description: The new name for the label. Must be a string with a length from 0 to 16384 characters. If omitted, the name remains unchanged.
name.title: Name

name: update_labels_by_id_label

data.description: The details of the updated label.
data.title: Data

UpdateLabelsByIdLabelResponseData.description: Response data for the updated label.

color.description: The color of the label, or null if no color is set.
color.title: Color

id.description: The unique identifier of the updated label.
id.title: Id

idBoard.description: The ID of the board the label belongs to.
idBoard.title: Id Board

uses.description: The number of cards using this label.
uses.title: Uses

UpdateLabelsByIdLabelResponseData.title: UpdateLabelsByIdLabelResponseData
